async def act(page):
    # 1) Open the Inventory tab to reveal Stock Availability
    await page.get_by_role("link", name="Inventory").click()
    # allow the panel to render
    await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)

    # 2) Set Stock Availability to "Out of Stock" using the <select> (combobox)
    out_of_stock_label = "Out of Stock"
    selected = False

    # Try the most likely accessible names first for precision
    possible_names = [
        "Stock Availability *",
        "Stock Availability",
    ]

    for name in possible_names:
        try:
            combo = page.get_by_role("combobox", name=name)
            await combo.select_option(label=out_of_stock_label)
            selected = True
            break
        except Exception:
            # not found or option not present, try next
            pass

    # If not found by name, iterate all comboboxes and try selecting the label
    if not selected:
        combos = page.get_by_role("combobox")
        count = await combos.count()
        for i in range(count):
            combo = combos.nth(i)
            try:
                await combo.select_option(label=out_of_stock_label)
                selected = True
                break
            except Exception:
                continue

    # 3) Save the product to persist the change. Do this last since it may navigate away.
    await page.wait_for_timeout(500)
    await page.get_by_role("button", name="Save").click()
